subject: Grinder jams on the darkest roast
body: Customer reported the EK43 jamming when grinding our darkest roast. Cause was oil build-up on the burrs from a high-oil bean. Advised cleaning with grinder tablets every 20 kilograms rather than the standard 40 for oily roasts.
resolution: Cleaning schedule adjusted. No hardware fault found.

subject: Wholesale bag arrived without a degassing valve
body: A 1 kilogram wholesale bag was delivered with no one-way valve fitted. Without the valve, carbon dioxide from fresh roast has nowhere to escape and the bag can split.
resolution: Replacement shipped same day. Batch checked; a single sealing head was misaligned and has been recalibrated.

subject: Cold brew tastes flat compared to last order
body: Customer steeped cold brew for 8 hours instead of the recommended 16, using a medium grind rather than coarse. Under-extraction produced a thin, flat cup.
resolution: Advised a 1:8 ratio, coarse grind and a full 16 hour steep at room temperature. Customer confirmed the next batch was correct.

subject: Is the decaf processed with chemicals?
body: Customer asked whether our decaf uses solvent-based decaffeination. It does not. We use the Swiss Water method, which uses only water and carbon filtration, and removes 99.9 percent of caffeine.
resolution: Explained the Swiss Water process. Customer satisfied.

subject: Refund requested for an opened bag
body: Customer opened a bag of Halcyon and disliked the pronounced grapefruit acidity. Halcyon is a deliberately bright coffee and this is expected of the profile.
resolution: Store credit issued as a goodwill gesture. Customer redirected to Meridian, which suits a general palate better.
